relations.subject: Constantin Regamey
relations.evidence: In 1931, he received a degree from the University of Warsaw in oriental and classical philology.

relations.subject: Constantin Regamey
relations.evidence: He became a lecturer there in 1936.

relations.subject: Constantin Regamey
relations.evidence: He later studied composition formally with Kazimierz Sikorski.

relations.subject: Constantin Regamey
relations.role: professor of Slavic and Oriental languages
relations.evidence: In 1945, he became professor of Slavic and Oriental languages at the University of Lausanne.

relations.subject: Constantin Regamey
relations.evidence: He also taught linguistics at the University of Fribourg beginning in 1946.
